name: Reaper: an equipped thrown weapon stays equipped after a relog (#10474)
contract: Issue #10474: Reapers (class 30) are granted Thrown (skill 176, spell 2567) by AscensionLiveBaseline::Proficiencies,
but SkillRaceClassInfo 233 (the sole row for skill 176) allowed classes 4, 10, 12 and 18 only (mask 133640).
At login _LoadSkills dropped skill 176 as invalid for class 30, so _LoadInventory rejected the equipped thrown
weapon with EQUIP_ERR_NO_REQUIRED_PROFICIENCY and mailed it back before OnPlayerLogin re-granted Thrown.
Expected: a level 33 Reaper equips Grave Spite (415041, RequiredLevel 32, INVTYPE_THROWN) in the ranged slot (17),
and after a relog Grave Spite stays in slot 17 and is not mailed.

steps.label: SETUP: Grave Spite is equipped in the ranged slot
DISCRIMINATING: Grave Spite stays equipped after the relog
DISCRIMINATING: Grave Spite was not mailed back
Thrown is still known after the relog
